pr_title: Allow only HTTP requests during X509 chain building
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/45010

This is a port of [5.0 change](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/commit/d070c3fb073067a894b2ca9ca3ce86709e4ad7e3). There was a merge conflict with https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/commit/fdc8148e9a8626da75f98f462f814946af35e5f1 which I have resolved here.

Adding @eerhardt to validate this will not produce new ILLink warnings.

This is a fix related to https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/175

cc: @karelz @Anipik
